5769.title: [Skia] Sync m159 image-filter cache equality fix
5769.body:
[Skia] Sync m159 image-filter cache equality fix (#5769)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/458
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5776
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/96ee011489be9ba83512abb766d0712a27eb1f18...1c8b6db33a5c9ff2292fb58d65d7b344e91085f3

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to native
merge 1c8b6db33a5c9ff2292fb58d65d7b344e91085f3, incorporating the
chrome/m159 cache-key fix at upstream
8a65fa27c104d1bb5a58df5ec3e0c1655053fcf6. Keep milestone 159 and package
and native ABI versions unchanged for this servicing update.

The image-filter cache hashes complete key bytes, while its former
fieldwise equality used numerical matrix comparison and ignored the
matrix's cached type mask. Signed zero, differing type-mask state and
runtime denormal handling could make equality inconsistent with hashing.
The native fix compares the complete key representation with memcmp,
using the constructor's existing type-mask initialization and explicit
padding. Its upstream regression checks signed zero, type masks,
colliding subnormal translations, LRU eviction and purge behavior.

Record the landed native history rather than the pre-merge PR head.
The native merge has two parents, directly contains reviewed commit
b57c805eedc66db3716e75ef6f5c8520be1be17b, and has the identical tree
7dbf928a42d7006783c6aaf4ae567b34f0d37824. The dependent repin updates
the gitlink and matching manifest fork hash together; the manifest's
upstream_merge_commit remains the upstream commit, not the fork merge.

The parent diff changes those two provenance files, not managed wrappers,
generated declarations or tests. Independent regeneration matched the
five maintained generator configurations, and the fork DEPS blob is
unchanged. Native tree equality preserves the reviewed content; it is
not a new native build or runtime/device test run.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5772.title: Build the docs site in parallel and validate it on every PR
5772.body:
* Build the docs site in parallel and validate it on every PR

The Pages workflow built the docs and all three WASM apps serially in one
job, and only built PRs with the automation/staging label. When the Uno 7
migration broke the Uno Gallery smoke test (#5771), nothing caught it on the
PR and every main run since has failed, so the docs stopped publishing.

Split the build into setup, docs, wasm-natives, an app matrix and a quick
assemble job. Each app uploads its output only after it builds and passes
its smoke test; assemble copies whichever apps exist and warns about any
that are missing. Every PR, including forks, now builds and smoke-tests the
site and fails on any error. Publishing still requires a same-repo PR with
automation/staging, or a push/dispatch. On main, app jobs are
continue-on-error so a broken app is omitted rather than blocking the docs.

Relates to #5771

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Separate site validation from production and preview deployment

Build every PR event, including forks and label changes. Only publish production from main or staging for explicitly labeled same-repository PRs, and require successful app builds before publishing a PR preview.\n\nGate Go Live on the upstream publishing job rather than workflow success so validation-only and dry-run builds do not redeploy Pages.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5735.title: Use the internal Skia mirror for Azure build-job checkouts
5735.body:
* Use the internal Skia mirror for Azure build-job checkouts

Route internal package and test job submodule fetches through the existing mono-skia mirror with process-scoped URL rewriting and repository-scoped OAuth authentication. Explicitly reference the repository for protected job access, retain pinned sources and public GitHub checkout, and document the separate 1ES SDL checkout limitation.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Keep mirror routing in the existing checkout steps

Select internal routing from System.TeamProject and use Git command-scoped configuration with a step-local authorization environment variable. Remove the separate checkout template and configuration setup script while preserving inherited Git configuration and cache-miss timing.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Configure the Skia mirror once for every internal build job

Apply the non-secret global URL rewrite before checkout, independent of native job type or cache status. Reference the mirror in every internal bootstrapper job and retain step-local, mirror-scoped OAuth headers without persisting tokens.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Use explicit submodule checkout in public and internal jobs

Always check out self without submodules and share the existing cache-aware Git step. Remove project and cache-configuration branching from full submodule initialization while respecting checkoutSubmodules and skipSteps.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Drop internal CI details from the developer build guide

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Expand optional mirror authentication in shared checkout commands

Set SKIA_GIT_OPTIONS to the header config option only for internal jobs and to empty for public jobs, avoiding duplicated Git commands. Keep global routing and checkout-step token scope unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5741.title: [M159] Sync upstream glyph and Vulkan OOM fixes
5741.body:
[M159] Sync upstream glyph and Vulkan OOM fixes (#5741)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/453
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5757
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/1b7b8c4340f57877940b47d24ada18eb6ec66e68...96ee011489be9ba83512abb766d0712a27eb1f18

Advance the Skia gitlink and Component Governance registration to the landed
native merge, 96ee011489be9ba83512abb766d0712a27eb1f18, and record upstream
chrome/m159 revision 7a06b6cf9fc9fe32f8906c63da21a4e35f7e9f15.
This is a same-milestone servicing sync; package and ABI versions remain
unchanged.

The dependent repin records the actual two-parent native merge rather than
the reviewed branch head. Its tree was verified identical to reviewed commit
9f50c1175e1de5b949820c9528594ccc3fde3979, preserving the reviewed native
contents while retaining the landed merge ancestry.

~~ Mask-filtered glyph reload divergence ~~

Bring in the SkScalerContext::getImage hardening for stateful font scalers
whose successive glyph loads disagree about paths, mask formats or bounds.
The native fix rasterizes the reloaded glyph rather than stale initial
state, clears incompatible masks instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and
uses full plane strides when copying clipped emboss masks. Regression cases
also preserve overlapping SDF data and exercise changing path geometry.

~~ Imagination Vulkan descriptor allocation failures ~~

Bring in the Ganesh and Graphite workaround for descriptor-set allocation
returning host or device OOM on Imagination drivers. The affected pool is
deliberately abandoned because destroying it can trigger a driver failure;
Graphite also refuses further allocation through the abandoned handle.
The workaround is restricted to that vendor and those allocation errors.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5732.title: Synchronize post-deadline screenshot confirmation test
5732.body:
* Investigate screenshot deadline regression

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Synchronize post-deadline screenshot confirmation test

The confirmation fixture wrote a matching screenshot but awaited a 20ms timer before completing capture. When that continuation is delayed beyond the bounded confirmation budget, Golden correctly reports the cached 2x2 first mismatch instead.\n\nControl the pending confirmation explicitly, preserving real asynchronous capture coverage and the original deadline. Assert the expired budget, pending second capture, 2x2-to-4x4 transition, exactly two attempts, and successful attachment behavior without changing production retries or tolerances.
